This Cookie Policy describes how Buyavdeals.online (“we,” “us,” or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website https://buyavdeals.online (the “Website”).

Buyavdeals.online operates as an independent reseller of antivirus software, computer peripherals, and related technology products in the United States. This policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and the choices available to you.

This Cookie Policy forms part of our Privacy Policy.

Buyavsdeals is owned and operated by AllRoundFix LLC, a company committed to delivering reliable products, transparent pricing, and a secure online shopping experience.

Understanding Cookies

Cookies are small data files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognize your device, maintain secure sessions, and improve functionality and performance during future visits.

Cookies do not typically contain personal data such as your name or contact details, but they may be linked to information collected through other means.

Cookies Used on Our Website

Essential Cookies

These cookies are required for the Website to work correctly. They support basic functions such as secure navigation, transaction processing, and fraud detection. Disabling these cookies may prevent certain features—such as purchasing antivirus licenses or accessories—from functioning properly.

Analytics Cookies

Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use our Website. They collect technical and usage information, such as visit duration, page interactions, and system performance. This data helps us improve Website reliability and user experience.

All analytics information is processed in aggregated form.

Preference Cookies

Preference cookies store your selected settings, such as language or browsing preferences, so you do not have to reconfigure them each time you visit the Website.

Marketing Cookies

Marketing cookies may be used to present promotions related to antivirus software and peripheral devices that are relevant to your interests. These cookies can also help us measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.

Marketing cookies may be placed by us or by authorized third-party partners.

Cookies from Third Parties

Some features on our Website rely on services provided by third parties, such as analytics tools, payment processors, or security services. These providers may set their own cookies according to their privacy policies.

We do not control how third-party cookies operate and recommend reviewing the policies of those providers for more details.

Purpose of Cookie Usage

Cookies help us to:

  • Maintain Website security and stability
  • Enable product browsing and checkout functionality
  • Improve Website design and performance
  • Understand customer interaction with our content
  • Present relevant product offers and promotions
  • Meet legal and compliance obligations

Managing Cookies

You can manage cookie settings directly through your browser. Most browsers allow you to block cookies, delete existing cookies, or receive alerts before cookies are stored.

Please be aware that restricting cookies may limit certain Website features or reduce overall usability.

United States Privacy Rights (All States)

We respect privacy rights provided under U.S. state laws, including but not limited to:

  • California (CCPA / CPRA)
  • Virginia (VCDPA)
  • Colorado (CPA)
  • Connecticut (CTDPA)
  • Utah (UCPA)

Depending on your state of residence, you may have rights to:

  • Request information about data collected through cookies
  • Request deletion of certain personal data
  • Opt out of targeted advertising, where applicable

Buyavdeals.online does not sell personal information.

Requests related to privacy rights may be submitted using the contact details below.

Updates to This Policy

This Cookie Policy may be revised periodically to reflect changes in laws, technologies, or business operations. Any changes will become effective once posted on this page.
